summary: Completed testing of Signature + PDF Integration workflow. Fixed critical bug where /api/interventions/{id}/complete-with-signature was returning 422 due to FastAPI body parameter wrapping issue. All 12 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend SignaturePad component works correctly. PDF factures include intervention signature when linked.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: /api/interventions/{id}/complete-with-signature endpoint had FastAPI body parameter issue - when multiple body params exist, FastAPI expects them wrapped
Solution: Changed geo parameter from body to query params (geo_latitude, geo_longitude, geo_accuracy)
pdf_generator.py: build_signature_section() correctly decodes base64 signature and embeds in PDF
pdf_generator.py: build_photos_section() creates 2-column grid of intervention photos
factures.py: get_facture_pdf() fetches intervention.signature_client when facture.intervention_id exists
SignaturePad.jsx: Generates canvas.toDataURL('image/png') as base64 signature
updated_files: /app/backend/routers/interventions.py - Fixed complete-with-signature endpoint to accept body directly without wrapping, geo via query params
/app/frontend/src/pages/TechnicianApp.jsx - Updated to send geo as query params instead of body
seed_data_creation: Test interventions created with TEST_ prefix for testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Signature + PDF integration fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) POST /api/interventions/{id}/complete-with-signature accepts signature data directly in body (not wrapped), geo via query params. 2) POST /api/interventions/{id}/signature - standalone signature endpoint. 3) GET /api/factures/{id}/pdf - includes intervention signature if facture.intervention_id exists. 4) SignaturePad component generates base64 PNG signature. 5) PDF generator embeds signature image in 'Signature du client' section.

test_1_tech_login.evidence: Tech can login and see interventions list

test_2_start_intervention_with_geoloc.evidence: POST /api/interventions/{id}/start accepts geo data, stores in geo_debut

test_3_signature_standalone_endpoint.evidence: Signature saved to intervention without completing

test_6_frontend_signature_pad.evidence: Canvas drawing works, generates base64 PNG, validates signer name

bug_1.root_cause: FastAPI requires multiple body parameters to be wrapped in JSON object with parameter names as keys. Frontend was sending data directly.
bug_1.fix_applied: Changed geo parameter from body (InterventionGeoLocation) to query params (geo_latitude, geo_longitude, geo_accuracy). Updated frontend to send geo as query params.

mocked_apis.note: All signature and PDF generation uses real implementation. Signature stored as base64 PNG in MongoDB.
